resources.string: ① Allow display over other apps
How much the pet shakes when you type. \"None\" just switches images without moving.
When ON, the pet appears automatically whenever you open another app. When OFF, it only shows after tapping button ③.
When ON, taps pass through to the app underneath and the pet can\'t be dragged.
Used whenever you haven\'t added any custom images in the Images tab.
Android doesn\'t allow apps to change their own icon after install. Instead, you can add a shortcut with an image you pick to the home screen. Use that shortcut to open the app.
Pick an image and add to home screen
This device doesn\'t support adding icons to the home screen
Shown when you\'re not typing. With several, one is picked at random each time it goes idle. If empty, the first image of a typing set (or the built-in color) is used.
While typing, images in a set cycle in numbered order. With several sets, one is picked at random each time you start typing.
When you type !, one of these is shown at random (nothing is saved or sent \u2014 it only checks in the moment whether the symbol was typed).
When you type ?, one of these is shown at random.
